name: Cigales (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided with a green hoist third and a red fly, the green charged with the crowned arms of Cigales (a castle on blue within a border of fleurs-de-lis).
history: The arms were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 27 July 1992. The flag was officially approved in 1999 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 21 January 1999: square, of proportion 1:1, tierced at the hoist green and red, with the municipal arms in their colours on the first partition.
